p: put my cup: We may not use this example to justify any unlawful practices, seeing God has commanded us to walk in simplicity.

whereby indeed he divineth: Because the people thought he could divine, he attributes to himself that knowledge: or else he pretends that he consults with soothsayers: which deceit is worthy to be reproved.
rent their clothes: To show how greatly the thing displeased them and how sorry they were for it.
God hath found out the iniquity: If we see no obvious cause for our affliction, let us look to the secret counsel of God, who punishes us justly for our sins.
as Pharaoh: Equal in authority or, next to the king.
wife bare me two sons: Rachel bore to Jacob, Joseph and Benjamin.
ye shall bring down my gray: You will cause me to die for sorrow.
how shall I go up to: Meaning, he would rather remain as their prisoner, than to return and see his father in sorrow.
